capabilities: Create and maintain symlinks from vault skill folders into agent skill folders
Route skills per group, per skill, or to separate Claude Code profiles
Preview every link that would be created or removed before syncing
Repair recorded links after vault moves and update paths on folder renames
Suggest Claude Code config folders found on the computer
disambiguation: Not a general symlink manager; it only links vault skill folders into AI agent skill and config folders.
extras: Desktop only; on Windows the links are directory junctions. Sync is off after install, and a command removes all created links before uninstalling. Installable via BRAT.
problem: Coding agents read skills from folders outside the vault, so skills edited in Obsidian must be copied or linked by hand to reach each agent.

relations.evidence: a Claude profile is a Claude Code config folder, ~/.claude by default
Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and most other agents read ~/.agents/skills
Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and most other agents read ~/.agents/skills

requires.name: an AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor

summary: Symlink manager that keeps AI agent skills in the vault and links them into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents' skill folders.
